sources.title: Multivariate quantum signal processing with optimal query complexity
sources.recorded_claim: Under the stated model, each variable is queried as many times as its degree; the authors report optimal query complexity.
limitations: preprint not independently reproduced by UQPU
bound depends on exact signal/oracle model and polynomial class
query count is not total cost or wall-clock time

sources.title: Quantum Algorithms for Multivariable Polynomial Transformations: From Efficient Synthesis to Quantum Channel Transformations
sources.recorded_claim: The preprint reports O(D/sqrt(tau)) queries under joint block access with (1+tau)-optimal normalization, and exactly D under its row-block access setting.
limitations: coherent Kraus/channel access assumptions are not mapped to an actual provider

sources.title: Polynomial time constructive decision algorithm for multivariable quantum signal processing
sources.recorded_claim: The paper provides a theorem-scoped M-QSP feasibility decision and constructive parameter method.
limitations: not a general application query bound
not a hardware, cost or physical advantage result
